episode.title: This 1957 Kitchen Ad Went Into Orbit
episode.headline:
WHY ARE THE
CABINETS FLYING?

beats.text: This nineteen fifty-seven kitchen ad turned cabinets into flying saucers. All to sell a better kitchen.
In this dream, even the floor plan gets dramatic: look at all those extra steps.
and the cabinets head into orbit. It’s an elaborate fantasy about making housework simpler.
And the grand finale of this cosmic adventure? A kitchen-planning booklet.
